battle_traits.name: The Faces of the Bad Moon
battle_traits.declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round. If multiple players are commanding a Gloomspite Gitz army, then instead, at the start of the battle round, those players roll off and only the winner declares and uses this ability this battle round.
battle_traits.effect: If it is the first battle round, pick the starting face of the Bad Moon (Grinnin', Scowlin', Sulkin' or Cacklin'). If it is not the first battle round, the face of the Bad Moon moves to the next face in the sequence.

battle_traits.name: Creeping Gloom
battle_traits.declare: Pick a terrain feature to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while friendly non-MONSTER non-WAR MACHINE GLOOMSPITE GITZ units are wholly within 3" of that terrain feature, they are not visible to enemy units more than 9" away.

battle_traits.name: Under the Light of the Bad Moon
battle_traits.effect: During the battle, the effects below apply to friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ units based on the current face of the Bad Moon:

options.name: Frothing Zealots
options.text: While the Bad Moon is Cacklin' or Grinnin', add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-SQUIG MOONCLAN units.

options.name: Spiderfang Venom
options.text: While the Bad Moon is Cacklin' or Grinnin', combat attacks made by friendly SPIDERFANG units score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+. This ability also affects Companion weapons.

options.name: Moonlit Hide
options.text: While the Bad Moon is Grinnin' or Scowlin', subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target friendly TROGGOTH units.

options.name: Lunar Squigs
options.text: While the Bad Moon is Scowlin' or Sulkin', instead of rolling the dice to determine the Move characteristic of a friendly SQUIG unit, you can use a value of 4.

options.name: Sneaky Snarlfangs
options.text: While the Bad Moon is Sulkin' or Cacklin', friendly GITMOB units can use CHARGE and SHOOT abilities even if they used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Spreading Loonacy
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-SQUIG MOONCLAN or SPIDERFANG units in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move with the target.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Herd Healing
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly TROGGOTH unit uses a FIGHT ability, after that ability has been resolved, Heal (D3) that unit.

abilities.name: Bouncing Fury
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly SQUIG unit charges, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its Fang-filled Gobs, Massive Fang-filled Gobs or Huge Fang-filled Gobs for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Git and Run
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly GITMOB unit that is in combat to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with that GITMOB unit to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.
abilities.effect: If you picked a target, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat range of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Extra Snappy
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly GITMOB units that charged this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of Companion weapons used by the targets for the rest of turn.

abilities.name: Grots Upon Grots
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-SQUIG MOONCLAN unit that is contesting an objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the control score of the target unit for each model in that unit that is not contesting any objectives.

entries.name: The Clammy Hand
entries.effect: Each time a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

entries.name: Loontouched
entries.effect: If this unit is not a WIZARD, it has WIZARD (1). Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

entries.name: Fight Another Day
entries.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

entries.name: The Clammy Cowl
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

entries.name: Backstabber's Blade
entries.declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.name: Leering Gitshield
entries.effect: Each time an unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the ATTACK ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Fizzcap
entries.effect: This unit can use a SUMMON SPELL ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had WIZARD (1). Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 12 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound. Then, if this unit is not MOONCLAN, roll a dice. On a 1-4, 1 model in this unit is automatically slain.

entries.name: Spoofshrooms
entries.effect: Roll a dice. If this unit is GITMOB, roll D3+3 instead. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

entries.name: Glitzy Bitz Rolla
entries.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

If this unit is a non-TROGGOTH unit, add 1 to wound rolls for its attacks for the rest of the turn.

If this unit is a TROGGOTH, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Set the Damage characteristic of this unit's Colossal Boulder Club to 6.
• Set the Damage characteristic of this unit's Throwin' Boulders to 3.
• Set the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Noxious Vomit to 3.

entries.name: Bad Portents
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, nothing happens. On a 3-5, the face of the Bad Moon moves to the next face. On a 6, pick a new face of the Bad Moon for this battle round.

entries.name: Spore Maws
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.name: The Hand of Gork
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 24" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Bright Fright
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick up to 3 friendly visible GLOOMSPITE GITZ units wholly within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Each target can immediately use a RETREAT ability as if it was your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on the targets by those RETREAT abilities.

entries.name: Gitspeed
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-TROGGOTH GLOOMSPITE GITZ units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Gaze of Glareface
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target cannot use RUN abilities.
• Halve the Range characteristic of the target's ranged weapons.

entries.name: Summon Mork's Mighty Mushroom
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Mork's Mighty Mushroom on the battlefield, pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Mork's Mighty Mushroom wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Summon Scuttletide
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Scuttletide on the battlefield, pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Scuttletide wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Scrapskuttle's Arachnacauldron
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Scrapskuttle's Arachnacauldron on the battlefield, pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Scrapskuttle's Arachnacauldron wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Malevolent Moon
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Moon on the battlefield, pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Malevolent Moon wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Itchy Nuisance
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are contesting the target objective.

entries.name: Loonshrine Glow
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, if a friendly Bad Moon Loonshrine uses the 'Moonclan Lairs' ability, you can set up the replacement unit wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units instead of wholly within 12" of that Bad Moon Loonshrine.

entries.name: Puffballoons
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time an ability inflicts damage points on the target, after the ability has been resolved, the target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
